sense: a commander in the armed forces

evidence: Traupman 187: officer, praefectus; cavalry officer, praefectus equitum

terms.gloss: a military tribune, a senior officer of a legion
a centurion, commander of a century

phrases.latin: corvus repentē inprōvīsus advolat et super galeam tribūnī īnsistit
phrases.english: suddenly, out of nowhere, a raven flies up and settles on the tribune’s helmet

sources: Lewis & Short: praeficio · Lewis & Short: tribunus · Lewis & Short: centurio
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 186–187.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. officer (military).
